name: The film, rough cut A
title: The film, rough cut, spotlight overlays
story: The whole film in the spotlight style: the hero frame and its three points, the split, the board draining as work resolves, new work filing itself, one sentence becoming a plan whose four cards land, a merge approved by hand, the dial at full auto, the supervisor after a stall, a question only Sebastian answers, the delivery metrics, the sandbox, the closing line. Captions only, no voice.
